cache: Fresh child and one initial rank-cache clear. Cold=one batch with natural intra-batch cache reuse; warm=paid full batch then complete second batch, cache retained. OS filesystem cache uncontrolled.
data_origin: Existing retained noVNC normalized numeric histories and pseudonymous labels. Not source snapshots, independently recoded identity/origin truth, natural deployment traces, or 40 repositories.

environment_observations.correctness_mode: no live resource counters or duration clocks; API arithmetic tested with fake data
environment_observations.cpu_model: HKLM/HARDWARE/DESCRIPTION/System/CentralProcessor/0 ProcessorNameString; null plus reason on failure
environment_observations.host_cpu_scope: all processors for <=64; calling primary processor group above 64
environment_observations.host_load: GetSystemTimes cumulative idle/kernel-including-idle/user 100-ns counts plus GlobalMemoryStatusEx physical memory; bracketing deltas only, not an instantaneous CPU percentage
environment_observations.lock_scope: four-slot wrapper coordinates this project's participating HistoryLedger cost jobs only; unrelated applications and OS work remain possible
environment_observations.timestamps: real timezone-aware UTC at campaign start/end and before/after each host snapshot

measurement_entry: run-measurement.ps1 -ArtifactRoot <artifact-root> -OutputDir <fresh-output-dir> -PythonExecutable <python> -Run; bundled-equivalent wrapper starts coordinator only after acquiring four project slots
process_accounting: Launch CPython base executable directly; payload PID and PPID must match Popen/coordinator; whole CPU covers disjoint phases; observed memory joins same-process samples only.

runtime_locations.artifact_root: required CLI parameter; version checked against relative artifact_sha256 entries
runtime_locations.output_dir: required fresh CLI parameter outside this cost-script directory
runtime_locations.resource_wrapper: bundled by default; optional equivalent supplied path; no external tool dependency

shared_components: input validator and frozen numeric convention
whole rewrite certificate producer and receiver

units.cpu_and_wall: nanoseconds; GetProcessTimes raw counts also kept in 100-ns units
units.event_weights: integer multiples of 1e-12 frozen weight quantum
units.memory: bytes; peak working set and private commit separately
